verdict.rationale: LobeChat documents its own Ollama integration in the self-hosting guide, and it can be self-hosted with local-by-default data storage, so a local-model setup is supported for at least one backend. The evidence is only a doc-page title, though, and the other named backends and fully offline operation are not shown. Missing for 10: documented llama.cpp, LM Studio and vLLM support; evidence the assistant runs with no cloud model dependency at all; substantive Ollama setup detail; independent or hands-on corroboration of a fully local run.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, I can run the assistant entirely on local models — Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, or vLLM — with no cloud model dependency

citations.quote: LobeHub can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, giving you complete control over your data, customization, and deployment environment.
LobeChat chat data is stored locally on the client-side by default.
